# Slow Worker

> Bilingual (FR/EN) marketplace of calm, skilled freelancers. Find the right profile at the right pace.

Slow Worker connects companies with freelancers across branding, UX, and development. Companies browse without signing up; freelancers maintain a public profile with skills, availability, and portfolio.

## Pages

- [Accueil / Home](/): Landing page introducing Slow Worker.
- [Trouver un freelance / Browse freelancers](/browse): Searchable directory filtered by skill and availability.
